contentMode: Safe customs-service fallback. The planned IOR and De Minimis article routes were found only in planning documents, not as reviewed/published Chinese article files.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one standalone horizontal website section for an existing premium logistics landing page
Primary request: Add the missing S6 customs and policy information section to the established PNPLINE v2 concept. Use the safe fallback content because no reviewed/published Chinese policy articles were found. Do not present current policy facts, dates, tariffs, legal conclusions, certifications, or news cards.
Input images: Image 1 is the current WMS section immediately before S6; Image 2 is the current cost section immediately after S6. Use them only as visual-system references for typography, spacing, cyan accent, photography grade, and rounded geometry. Do not copy their layouts.
Scene/backdrop: a deep navy-to-ink atmospheric field, #102A39, with a subtle low-chroma vignette and faint paper-grain texture; this darker interlude creates scroll rhythm between two light sections.
Subject: an art-directed macro editorial photograph of anonymous customs-document review on the right two-thirds: hands aligning an unbranded kraft shipping document sleeve, clean generic papers with no readable private data, a blue folder tab, and the edge of a plain kraft parcel with cyan tape. No passport, ID number, customs seal, government emblem, signature, barcode data, certification badge, currency, tariff table, or fake official form. Photograph is conceptual and must not look like evidence.
Style/medium: realistic premium B2B website UI mockup with cinematic editorial logistics photography; crisp Simplified Chinese; implementation-ready, not concept art.
Composition/framing: off-grid image-as-canvas composition, not a generic left-text/right-image split. Large photographic crop begins near center and bleeds to the right and bottom; a translucent navy gradient creates a clean text safe area in the upper-left. Add one narrow vertical cyan editorial index rail near the left edge with three stacked markers: 商品资料 / IOR需求 / 责任边界. Place a single refined frosted-white/very pale ice-blue information panel overlapping the lower-left edge of the photograph. The panel is wide and low, not three equal cards. Use generous whitespace and a restrained thin cyan line.
Lighting/mood: cool natural window light, navy shadows, warm kraft paper, calm precision, trustworthy and serious.
Color palette: PNPLINE cyan #00ABE1, action teal #007FA8, navy #102A39, ice blue #F3F8FA, white #FFFFFF, warm kraft. No green, sage, purple, red, neon glow, or rainbow gradient.
Text (verbatim):
Eyebrow: "清关与政策"
Large headline, two balanced lines: "发货前，先确认清关" / "与政策适用条件"
Supporting text: "结合商品、交易资料与发货方案，了解需要进一步核实的进口与政策问题。"
Information panel label: "进口清关 · 服务范围"
Information panel title: "先了解进口清关的服务范围"
Information panel body: "围绕商品资料、IOR需求与责任边界，准备需要在咨询中确认的问题。"
CTA as an underlined inline link with arrow, not a filled pill: "了解清关与合规 ↗"
Small photo caption: "概念示意 · 非实际申报文件"
Small bottom note: "具体服务范围与适用条件，以确认后的方案为准。"
Constraints: render exactly one focused horizontal 16:9 section at 1672×941 or larger; no site header, footer, browser chrome, device frame, or extra section. Use Noto Sans SC-like typography with highly legible exact Chinese. Keep the headline strong but not oversized. The photograph must be structurally important and occupy more than half the canvas. This is a calm dark editorial interlude with one information panel and one CTA.
Avoid: two policy/news article cards, "latest" badges, publication dates, reviewer names, claims that IOR/Bond is held, De Minimis facts, tariff rates, policy summaries, legal advice, checkmarks, shields, scales of justice, courthouse imagery, flags, fake documents, dashboard UI, three-card layouts, generic icons, fake metrics, invented contact information, or typed PNPLINE wordmarks.
